attempted_claim: Prove or disprove that the Ueda-type amalgamated free product II_1 factor M = M_1 *_A M_2 over a common Cartan subalgebra A, with M_1 and M_2 explicit hyperfinite crossed products sharing A = L^infinity([0,1]) through two explicit free ergodic actions in the sense of Ueda amalgamation over a Cartan, has exactly one Cartan subalgebra up to unitary conjugacy, namely the amalgam A; since M has a Cartan by construction, the Ioana amalgamated-free-product Cartan-absence and Boutonnet-Houdayer-Raum free-product dichotomy theorems do not decide uniqueness; the bounded one-hour attack verifies the Ioana-Peterson-Popa Bass-Serre intertwining and relative Ozawa condition (AO) hypotheses on explicit finite generating sets of M_1, M_2 and A; a complete answer either proves that every Cartan of M is unitarily conjugate to A or exhibits a second Cartan subalgebra of M inequivalent to A, a new non-uniqueness boundary for amalgamation over a Cartan.
claim_type: prove-or-disprove unique Cartan up to conjugacy

Bernoulli shift F2 on {0,1}^F2 is one such action, explicitly flagship-covered. The remaining identification M1*_A M2 ~= A rtimes (Z*Z)=A rtimes F2 is standard folklore via Voiculescu/Ueda universal property and Fourier expansion, not a new lemma. Ioana Ann. Sci. ENS (2015) independently covers Gamma=Z*Z AFP-group case with unique Cartan. Thus submitted claim is a direct corollary / parameter substitution n=2 plus Bernoulli choice of known stronger fact, i.e. recomputation/certificate/repackaging. Title similarity alone was not relied on; hypothesis-conclusion comparison shows coverage. Admission missed Popa-Vaes dominance while citing only Ioana-absence and BHR dichotomy as non-deciding, so admitted originality premise was materially false: ADMISSION_DEFECT. value: FAIL: Correct corollary but no independent retrieval value under shared STANDARD. Here uniqueness for this one Bernoulli-F2 model is mechanically implied by Popa-Vaes general theorem for all free ergodic F_n actions; instantiating n=2 Bernoulli is a mere parameter substitution / textbook exercise. It does not establish a new non-uniqueness boundary, new census, cutoff, or downstream use; the claimed new boundary at amalgamation-over-Cartan is already decided by the 2014 theorem.
